title: A Ceiling Continued Fraction Approach to the Erdős-Straus Conjecture: Heuristic finiteness of counterexamples
summary: We introduce the Ceiling Continued Fractions (FCT) framework for constructing three-term Egyptian fraction representations in the Erdős--Straus conjecture from divisors of the shifted integers \(p+i\). A probabilistic model for their arithmetic structure leads to an asymptotic upper-bound heuristic for cumulative failure. The resulting bound is summable, and the first Borel--Cantelli lemma assigns probability zero to the event that infinitely many primes survive the full FCT block.
